title: C5 addressing and execution as separate measured quantities, gated before measurement
question: When the retained candidate set is reduced from H to K before structural execution, does an acceptable candidate survive addressing, and does CASM-S then compute the target relation on it — measured as two independent endpoints rather than as one selection score?
hypothesis: For the controlled multi-valid equality benchmark, exact addressing retains an acceptable candidate with probability near its analytic ceiling while executing at most K structures per query. The experiment separates retention from execution: the addressing endpoint is computed from the retained index and the hidden acceptable set alone and never from a CASM-S output, so it cannot inherit an execution failure. A pre-registered representability gate runs before the task stream and terminates the run as instrument-invalid if the frozen CASM-S cannot produce the required output under the exact execution path C5 uses, so an ambiguous capability number is not produced a second time.

arms.name: exhaustive
arms.intervention: execute every H candidate structure through the CASM-S evaluator, with addressing evaluated separately as the trivial retention of the full set

arms.name: exact-indexed
arms.intervention: content-address the candidate universe and execute only the retained K candidates, with the bucket compared against the acceptable set for the addressing endpoint

arms.name: representation-addressed
arms.intervention: retain candidates by fixed cosine similarity of public query bits and candidate descriptors, evaluated by the same addressing endpoint

endpoints.name: coverage_rate
endpoints.role: primary — addressing: an acceptable candidate is retained
endpoints.description: Fraction of measured queries where the retained set intersects the hidden acceptable-action set. Computed from the retained indices and the hidden acceptable set alone; no CASM-S output, selection or verification result enters it, so an execution failure cannot depress an addressing number.

endpoints.name: execution_accuracy_rate
endpoints.role: secondary — execution: the relation is computed correctly on a retained candidate
endpoints.description: Fraction of measured queries where the relation holds on a selected retained candidate. The acceptable set is hidden from the executor; the endpoint reads only the public relation, the selected candidate's descriptor and the executed output.

endpoints.name: structures_executed_per_query
endpoints.description: Number of retained structures submitted to CASM-S per measured query.

endpoints.name: active_nodes_per_query
endpoints.description: Active CASM-S nodes across executed retained structures per query.

endpoints.name: candidate_edges_per_query
endpoints.description: Candidate edges presented to CASM-S across all executed retained structures per query.

endpoints.name: gate_evaluations_per_query
endpoints.description: Per-edge CASM-S gate evaluations across executed retained structures per query.

endpoints.name: structural_operations_per_query
endpoints.description: Non-input CASM-S node operations executed per query.

endpoints.name: node_outputs_per_query
endpoints.description: Active CASM-S node outputs produced per query.

endpoints.name: casm_forward_batches
endpoints.description: Number of batched CASM-S forward calls over the measured query window. One forward can carry several structures, so this is never read as a structure count.

endpoints.name: address_positions_per_query
endpoints.description: Candidate positions the content-address index inspects per query. This is the addressing arm's own work measure and is zero on arms that do not use the index — so it is what separates an addressing cost from an execution cost, which a single work total cannot show.

endpoints.name: representation_candidates_scored_per_query
endpoints.description: Candidates the fixed cosine scorer evaluates per query. Registered so the representation arm's addressing cost is visible as a cost rather than only as a coverage number, and so the arm cannot appear free.

endpoints.name: wall_clock_seconds
endpoints.description: Measured runtime of the C5 query window on the declared hardware. A diagnostic, never a capability endpoint.

endpoints.name: verification_rate
endpoints.description: Fraction of measured queries where the verifier agrees that the executed output matches the public relation. Zero across all arms is the signature of an instrument failure, not of a negative result.

decision_rule.condition: the pre-registered representability gate fails on held-out structures
decision_rule.licenses: the run terminates as instrument-invalid and no C5 capability number is reported; the failure is recorded against the gate, not against CASM-S as a substrate
decision_rule.does_not_license: any capability claim or negative capability claim, including that selective execution cannot work or that CASM-S cannot execute the relation

decision_rule.condition: exact-indexed coverage_rate is at or above its analytic ceiling within the seed spread while structures_executed_per_query is no greater than K
decision_rule.licenses: the tested exact addressing boundary retains an acceptable candidate at the analytic ceiling for this controlled benchmark, and the measured CASM-S work follows the retained set
decision_rule.does_not_license: semantic retrieval, learned addressing, or the full system-level C5 claim

decision_rule.condition: exact-indexed coverage_rate is materially below its analytic ceiling at the same H and K
decision_rule.licenses: retention loss is observed under the tested retained-set budget and is attributable to addressing rather than to execution, because the endpoint reads no CASM-S output
decision_rule.does_not_license: that selective execution or cheap addressing is impossible

decision_rule.condition: execution_accuracy_rate is materially below the gate-confirmed representability reference while coverage_rate is at its ceiling
decision_rule.licenses: the failure is localized to execution, and the coverage endpoint remains a valid addressing measurement
decision_rule.does_not_license: that addressing is the defect, or a general statement about CASM-S execution capability

decision_rule.condition: structures_executed_per_query or CASM work fails to decrease with the retained set under otherwise matched conditions
decision_rule.licenses: the implementation does not expose the intended structural work reduction and requires audit before a C5 interpretation
decision_rule.does_not_license: a general statement about CASM-S efficiency

held_constant: CASM-S source commit is pinned to c31554413301e3c9d3e6b3f8c8c6be572a74a748
the representability gate runs before the task stream and terminates the run on failure, so no capability number is emitted under an unrepresentative instrument
the gate evaluates held-out structures under the same ops, threshold, bridge calibration and execution path the task stream uses, not a proxy task
the coverage endpoint reads only retained indices and the hidden acceptable set; no CASM-S output, selection result or verification result may enter it
the acceptable set is hidden from the executor and from addressing; it is revealed only after execution for evaluation
same CASM-S model instance, checkpoint and evaluator are used across all arms
same candidate population and task stream are used for matched seed and H cells
candidate validity is multiple-valid on two marked equality positions
the exhaustive arm executes every candidate but must not use a CASM-S output to select for the coverage endpoint
the exact-indexed arm is the retention ceiling and analytic control, not a learned result
the representation-addressed arm is a fixed cosine baseline and is explicitly not a learned semantic-addressing result
no exhaustive fallback is permitted after an empty retained set
hidden target and acceptable_actions are used only after execution for evaluation
warmup queries are fixed at 3 and excluded from endpoint averages
CASM work is counted from the actual serialized graph submitted to the external model
